"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is an online E logbook to discuss our patient’s de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian’s signed informed consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHere we discuss our individual patient’s problems through series of inputs from an available global online community of experts to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence-based inputs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis e-log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box are welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E65year old female\u0026nbsp; came to opd with chief complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-fever since 20 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- pedal edema and facial puffiness since 20 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of presenting illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--Patients was apparently asymptomatic 20days ago then she developed fever which is insidious in onset gradually progressive ,low grade fever, intermittent, associated with body pains not associated with chills and rigors\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of nocturnal variation in fever pattern\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient when got fever 20days back she ignored it and went on her work\u0026nbsp; then she developed body pains which were insidious in onset gradually progressive they were unbearable for which she took a injection from local doctor and went for farming again, the following day morning she developed\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--pedal edema and\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--facial puffiness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-----Pedal edema was insidious in onset and it was pitting type below the knee\u0026nbsp; for which she went to a local hospital in miryalaguda they said to her she is having a kidney problem then she came to our hospital\u0026nbsp; where she as being evaluated and initiated on hemodialysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of decreased urine output\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of burning micturition\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of hematuria\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of shortness of breath ,cough,palpitations , chest tightness, sweating\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of weight-loss\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--No history of loss of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Econsciousness,giddiness,involuntary passage of urine and stools\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPast history:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E---She had persistent cough 30years for 6 months back for which she went to a hospital in mriyalaguda there she was diagnosed\u0026nbsp; with tuberculosis\u0026nbsp; and she was started on ATT medication but she didn’t use them regularly\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E---surgeries- tubectomy 35 years back after her 5th child\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a known case of htn diabetes asthma epilepsy\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFamily history--insignificant\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet-mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite- normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder-regular\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep- adequate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions-occasionally toddy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDaily routine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe wakes up at 4am , then complete her household work and have a cup of tea at 6am then packs her breakfast and go to work around 830\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E--she will complete her work and comes home have lunch by 1230\u0026nbsp; and sleep for a hour and leave for work at 2:30pm and comes back by 5:00pm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe takes dinner at 8:30pm and sleeps by 9-10 pm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENow as she is having pedal edema and generalised weakness she is unable to go for farming and at that time she is sleeping or have chitchat with her grandchildren\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneral examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-patient Is conscious,coherent,cooperative .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe main thing that I learned from my mistakes is to take a detailed history which will direct us to the defective physiology and pathology and make our diagnosis easy
